webgl-ssr-boundary.rule: Three.js and WebGL Canvas components MUST be imported with next/dynamic and { ssr: false }
webgl-ssr-boundary.rationale: Three.js relies on window, document, and WebGL contexts which don't exist in Node server environment.

gpu-memory-disposal.rule: All WebGL geometries, materials, textures, and renderer instances MUST be explicitly disposed on unmount.
gpu-memory-disposal.rationale: WebGL does not garbage-collect GPU VRAM automatically; failing to dispose leads to progressive browser tab memory leaks.

dpr-performance-cap.rule: Renderer pixel ratio MUST be capped at Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2).
dpr-performance-cap.rationale: Prevents GPU fill-rate collapse on high-DPI/Retina screens while preserving visual sharpness.

design-token-architecture.rule: Use three-layer token architecture: Primitives -> Semantic -> Component variables.
design-token-architecture.rationale: Enables instant re-theming, contrast compliance, and dark-mode switching without touching component JSX.

static-frontend-first.rule: The project is strictly client/frontend-first with no mandatory backend server; capable of static export.
static-frontend-first.rationale: Zero-maintenance edge deployment with lightning-fast FCP.
